title: Motivational Quote of the Day by Homer: ‘Be patient, my heart, for you have endured things worse...’ - Why ancient Greek wisdom matters in modern stress; Words of inspiration on power of self talk, self control and inner resilience
description: Homer's timeless insights provide a guiding light in trying times. His reflections on endurance and strength from the past become particularly relevant today. As we navigate the frenetic pace of modern life, cultivating emotional resilience is vital. Recalling our past achievements fosters the tenacity required to handle both career disappointments and personal hardships.

title: Mary Beard: 'Slavery, misogyny ... the ancient world has got some pretty nasty stuff'
description: Renowned British classicist Mary Beard says we can all still learn from antiquity, but warns against excessive reverence.

title: Author Emily Wilson on how she brings Homer's ancient poems back to life
description: Classicist Emily Wilson talks about her new book, 'Crossing the Wine Dark Sea,' a series of essays reflecting on translation and classic writing in the modern world.
